Operating Expenses is administrative expenses only, so Gross Profit less it ties to the row above profit before tax but excludes other income and the fair value movements, which the issuer prints between gross profit and operating profit; the panel has no row for them. Operating Profit (EBIT) here is Gross Profit less Operating Expenses on that same basis, kept for consistency with FY2025 and earlier. The issuer's own operating profit line, which nets other income and fair value movements, is 1,472,161.
